rulings.why: System 3, stanza 2 row: word 4 'lies' is printed lower-case, so the reader missed no capital; the page runs 'Through ad-ver-si-ty lies' on as one sentence. The 5.5.8.8.5.5 metre (5 + 5 syllables) and stanzas 1 and 3, which open their sixth line with a capital ('To', 'In') on the same note, put the line opening at 'lies', so the database's lines 5 (2 words) and 6 (5 words) are a whole split of that page line with the same words.
settles: 553 shape (shape2-61): stanza 2 line 6 opens on word 4 of stanza 2 row 3, which the page prints with no capital
